products.name: Workspace ONE to Intune Application Rebuild & Repackaging — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to rebuild and repackage the Workspace ONE application estate into Intune — inventory source apps, rebuild with correct detection and assignments, migrate deployment workflows, and validate each one before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Rebuild every app from Workspace ONE in Intune — and prove each one still deploys

Apps are where Workspace ONE migrations bog down: every Win32, store, and mobile app has to be rebuilt in Intune with correct detection, requirements, assignments, and configuration — and validated so nobody loses the software they work in. Done by hand it's slow and error-prone. This solution gives you a repeatable way to rebuild and repackage the Workspace ONE application estate into Intune: inventory the source apps, rebuild them with correct logic, migrate deployment/assignment workflows, and validate each one before cutover.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the app-migration model, mapping Workspace ONE app types to Intune (Win32 .intunewin, store apps, managed mobile apps), detection/requirement/assignment parity, app configuration, and the validation gate.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Workspace ONE app export/inventory, packaging tooling, per-platform app channels, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory source apps, prioritize and rebuild each in Intune with correct detection/requirements, recreate assignment workflows, handle app configuration, validate deployment, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — source-vs-target app inventory discovery, app install/detection validation, a rebuild coverage and deployment-success report, safe remediation of failed app installs, and an app-assignment group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Workspace ONE app rebuilt in Intune and proven to deploy — correct detection, requirements, and assignments, validated before cutover — so no user loses the software they work in, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1APP-Discovery.ps1 — enumerate Intune apps and build a source-vs-target rebuild gap list
    • WS1APP-Remediation.ps1 — safely re-drive a failed app install on this device (default -WhatIf)
    • WS1APP-Report.ps1 — rebuild-coverage and deployment-success report from Intune (Microsoft Graph)
    • WS1APP-Set-AppAssignmentTargeting.ps1 — create the pilot/broad app-assignment Entra groups
    • WS1APP-Validation.ps1 — confirm a rebuilt app installed and its detection rule matches locally

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
